title: 10/10 things quietly wrecking your focus
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Variant of 01 on the reference post's own topic (attention span) with Locturne's points; the morning lock is the confession.
caption: the third one is the whole problem. which one is you? #focus #screentime #productivity
check: slide 4: 'my mornings start scrolling'. Only if true for you

slides.heading: your phone _face up_ on the desk
slides.top: you're not using it. it's still _using you_
slides.text:
every light-up is a tiny decision

put it _face down_, or in a drawer

slides.heading: notifications on _for everything_
slides.top: group chats, sales, an app you opened once
slides.text:
each one costs more than the second it takes

turn off everything that _isn't a person_

slides.heading: your day starts _scrolling_
slides.top: the first hour sets the pace for the rest
slides.text:
my mornings used to start in bed on tiktok

now my apps stay _asleep_ until i've _walked_, so the day starts with me

slides.heading: you never let yourself be _bored_
slides.top: queue, kettle, lift: phone out every time
slides.text:
boredom is where your brain _tidies up_

let a few minutes stay _empty_

slides.heading: checking it _for the time_
slides.text:
a watch or a clock across the room

removes the _excuse_
